text: @huiliyi37/dsh-office 是面向 DSH 工具注册表的 Office 文档插件，默认注册表格、PDF、演示文稿和 Word 四类工具。它可读取、创建和编辑 XLSX、PDF、PPTX、DOCX 文件，并能重算工作簿公式、检查常见公式结构问题。表格工具支持范围读取、单元格修改和追加行；演示文稿可从幻灯片定义生成，也可替换文本；文档工具支持内容块、表格样式和水印。适合需要让 DSH 助手处理本地办公文件的用户。使用前需安装到 DSH 配置中，并可按工具族开关功能。

@huiliyi37/dsh-office adds office tools to DSH. It reads and edits XLSX, PDF, PPTX, and DOCX files, recalculates and audits formulas, and extracts document text. Create PDFs, decks, and Word files from structured content. Install in a DSH profile and disable unused tool families.
想让 DSH 帮我读取和修改 Excel 工作簿。
有没有办法把一批表格数据写成 xlsx 文件？
我想让助手检查工作簿里的公式错误和可疑结构。
能不能把 PDF 内容提取出来给模型阅读？
希望从内容块生成带表格和水印的 Word 文档。
我需要根据幻灯片定义创建或修订 PPTX。
让 DSH 把多个 PDF 合并，或按页码拆分文件。
I want my DSH assistant to read and update Excel workbooks.
Can I generate PDFs and extract their text into context?
I need to create or revise PowerPoint decks from slide content.
Help me produce formatted Word documents from structured content blocks.
@huiliyi37/dsh-office 的功能「电子表格读写编辑」：读取工作簿或指定区域、将二维数据写入新文件，并更新单元格、增加工作表或追加行。
@huiliyi37/dsh-office 的功能「公式重算与审计」：重算工作簿公式并报告错误值；结构审计检查范围漏行、公式覆盖和列内不一致等情况。
@huiliyi37/dsh-office 的功能「PDF 处理」：从内容块生成 PDF、提取 PDF 文本，也可合并文件或按页拆分和抽取。
@huiliyi37/dsh-office 的功能「演示文稿处理」：从幻灯片定义创建 PPTX，读取幻灯片文字和结构，并查找替换文本。
@huiliyi37/dsh-office 的功能「Word 文档处理」：从标题、段落、表格等内容块生成 DOCX，也可提取 DOCX 纯文本。
@huiliyi37/dsh-office 的功能「按工具族配置」：通过 enable.xlsx、pdf、ppt、docx 开关控制注册哪些工具族，默认全部启用。
dsh-office 使用工具参数中的本地文件路径读写文档；文档创建和编辑会将结果写到指定路径。配置开关可分别关闭四类工具。

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `xlsx_read` | List sheets of a `.xlsx`, or read one sheet as a markdown table (range-limited for large files; formula text preserved) |
| `xlsx_write` | Write a 2D array to a new `.xlsx` (formula cells, header bold, column widths, number formats) |
| `xlsx_edit` | Edit an existing `.xlsx`: add sheets, update cells (value or formula), append rows |
| `xlsx_recalc` | Recalculate every formula with a lightweight pure-TS engine and report error values (`#REF!`, `#DIV/0!`, `#VALUE!`, `#N/A`, `#NAME?`, `#NUM!`) with locations |
| `xlsx_audit` | Statically audit formula structure: array-formula traps, aggregation ranges missing rows, formulas overwritten by hardcoded values, inconsistent formulas in a column, self-references, division by zero |
| `pdf_create` | Generate a real PDF with headings, paragraphs, tables, lists, code blocks and footer page numbers; CJK text renders via an auto-detected system font |
| `pdf_read` | Extract text from a PDF for reading into context |
| `pdf_merge` | Merge multiple PDFs into one, in order |

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · Install & load：> **Compatibility**: `dsh` `0.1.0-rc.5`–`0.1.x` and the `0.2` line (including `0.2.0-rc.2`). DSH checks the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` peer range against the running `dsh` version, so `0.2.4` (`^0.1.0-rc.5` only) is rejected on `0.2.0-rc.2`. Cores on the `0.0.1` line are still refused: they install a second `dsh-tools` copy and crash every tool call with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`.

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · Full load (all 14 tools)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @huiliyi37/dsh-office
dsh --profile <name>
```

The first `dsh plugin` call initializes the profile (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`
is its first bundle) and appends this package to the profile's `bundles` list.
Launching the profile then registers all tools automatically.

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · Load only the families you need：Pass a `config` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` to enable/disable
per family. Omitted families stay enabled; set a family to `false` to
exclude it (useful to keep the tool surface small):

```yaml
section: Load only the families you need

text:
@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: dsh-office
      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-office'
      config:
        enable:
          xlsx: false      # skip spreadsheet tools
          pdf: true        # keep PDF tools
          ppt: false       # skip presentations
          docx: true       # keep Word tools
```

Families: `xlsx` (read/write/edit/recalc/audit), `pdf` (create/read/merge/split),
`ppt` (create/read/edit), `docx` (create/read).

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: dsh-office
      name: '@huiliyi37/dsh-office'
```

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · Skill：The package ships a usage skill (`skills/SKILL.md`, anthropics-compatible
format) that teaches the model large-file pagination and generation
discipline. Install it into a skill discovery root:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills && cp -r node_modules/@huiliyi37/dsh-office/skills/dsh-office ~/.dsh/skills/
```

@huiliyi37/dsh-office README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build   # tsc → lib/
npm test        # vitest: round-trip tests through the tool execute path
```
